reviewLimitation: This lock detects unreviewed patch drift; it does not independently prove authorship or implementation provenance.
prohibitedInputPolicy: Third-party product source, executables, launcher contracts, private interfaces, product-specific layouts, and product-specific symbol naming are not approved implementation inputs.

patches.responsibility: Provide project-owned cross-process Steam CEF client-surface integration in the upstream macOS driver.
Implement the project-owned D3DMetal public-interface bridge behind an explicit per-game activation contract.
Expose the project-owned, renderer-neutral macOS display-state, window-surface, Metal-view, and main-thread callback interface required by managed Metal renderers.
Enable the public Vulkan portability-enumeration contract for the bundled Metal translation layer.
Keep server state owned by the managed Steam Prefix instead of a shared host location.
Provide the app-group-scoped Mach service contract required by the bundled runtime sandbox.
Keep bundled runtime server locking compatible with the macOS app sandbox boundary.
Resolve executable mappings within the managed app-sandbox storage boundary.
Resolve runtime libraries from the self-contained ForgePlay bundle without host fallback discovery.

Optionally append bounded host-provided compatibility arguments to one selected child executable role, optionally limit that append to Chromium root processes, select the same-launch observation role independently, and record that observation role's final command line without replacing updater-owned files.

Provide process-scoped Steam game renderer environments, architecture-specific module ownership, D3DMetal and MetalFX/NGX bridge scoping, and planned-route, environment-failure, fallback, and allowlist-owned module-load evidence; the later manual-selection patch replaces its generation selector.

Keep Darwin pthread thread context valid on scoped D3DMetal-capable macOS/x86_64 game routes, mirror the Windows TEB slots required by translated code and Wine dispatchers, and restore saved native slots before pthread exit.

Synchronize the mutable Windows static-TLS pointer into Darwin's retained Win64-reserved GS slot and use reentrant Apple time conversion interfaces so libc does not overwrite the adjacent mirrored PEB slot.

Mark a Steam game child independently from renderer activation, synchronize its process-scoped environment, and implement the fixed signed Game Mode process-host entry while preserving process identity and Wine server context; the later direct-target scope patch limits this fail-closed entry to explicitly requested beta sessions.

Keep standard Steam sessions on the normal Wine loader; when the host is explicitly requested, derive a trusted Unix-only target identity independently for each resolved executable in a structural Steam library game tree so launcher-created game children enter the same fixed host, exclude shared redistributable infrastructure, and preserve the fixed Game Mode host process identity and icon.

Activate project-owned external-storage grant manifests explicitly at the earliest safe ntdll Unix loader and wineserver entry points; keep launches without a grant request unchanged, but fail closed before Windows Steam starts when a required grant is incomplete or rejected.

Replace automatic Direct3D generation and loader-stage routing with one exact renderer selected explicitly for each Steam session; preserve the host-requested D3DMetal NVIDIA compatibility variant while applying the shared D3DMetal backend; remove mixed/profile environment propagation and reject process creation when selection is missing, invalid, or cannot be materialized.

Preserve the host-owned manual renderer component and DLL-path controls across Steam self-reexecution while continuing to scrub active renderer state from Steam infrastructure; treat separator-delimited _CommonRedist descendants as infrastructure so redistributable installers do not enter the game renderer route.

Publish owner-private, launch-scoped Darwin PID and process-start identities from Wine loader and wineserver entry points; keep that trusted Unix launch identity immutable across child-supplied Windows environments; and bind wineserver to the exact launching ForgePlay PID and kernel start time so force-quit or crash terminates the managed prefix even when AppKit cleanup cannot run.
Apply an opt-in managed Windows font-family replacement contract in GDI and DirectWrite.
Apply an opt-in structural Steam game CEF browser-root policy that avoids incompatible out-of-process GPU startup while leaving CEF subprocesses and non-CEF executables unchanged.

Carry the user-selected D3DMetal vendor identity and scoped NVAPI bootstrap only into game descendants, route host-declared architecture-incompatible service helpers through base Wine, preserve transparent observations, normalize the selected network adapter presentation, translate Darwin IP_RECVTOS ancillary data into the Windows IP_TOS control-message contract for every Wine process, and expose or hide CoreAudio capture endpoints without changing socket transport or audio output.
Scope heap-zero transport to the canonical Helldivers 2 process lineage and keep GameGuard helpers on the base Wine renderer environment without disabling or bypassing anti-cheat validation.
Adapt the publicly identified Valve Wine heap-zero behavior to Wine 11.12 for the process heap and private heaps under the LGPL approved-derivative boundary.

Preserve GStreamer set-valued ACCEPT_CAPS semantics, convert raw caps only after negotiation fixes them, and fall back to system-memory Media Foundation samples when a D3D11 device cannot represent the negotiated video output as a 2D texture.

behaviorContracts.responsibility: Document the public behavior boundary used by the independent ForgePlay D3DMetal bridge, its prefix-owned MetalFX/NGX filename bridge, its scoped Darwin pthread/Windows TEB transition implementation, and its renderer-neutral macOS window-surface callback contract.
